articles.summary: Long-term uranium fundamentals continue to strengthen as uncovered utility requirements grow and reliable future supply becomes increasingly scarce. We examine how contracting dynamics, energy security priorities and structural supply constraints are reshaping the uranium market outlook.
articles.title: On the Cusp of a New Contracting Cycle

articles.summary: After one of the strongest years in decades for precious metals, 2026 has been a year of correction, consolidation and renewed perspective. With gold and silver beginning to rebound, CIO Maria Smirnova examines the macroeconomic forces behind this year's pullback, why the fundamental drivers for precious metals remain intact, and why today's valuations may present compelling long-term opportunities across bullion and mining equities.
articles.title: Gold and Silver: Looking Beyond the Correction

articles.summary: Copper is reaching record highs as a tightening supply picture collides with a new era of strategic demand. Constrained concentrate markets and slow mine growth are revealing just how little flexibility exists across the global copper supply chain. We examine why these dynamics reinforce our bullish outlook for copper and copper miners.
articles.title: Copper at Record Highs: Structural Demand Meets Constrained Supply

articles.summary: Five years ago, the Sprott Physical Uranium Trust (TSX U.U), or fondly "SPUT", began a new chapter in uranium investing. Since launching in July 2021, SPUT has become the world's largest physical uranium fund, providing investors with a transparent, exchange-listed vehicle that offers exposure to physical uranium without the operational risks associated with uranium mining companies.
articles.title: Celebrating Five Years of Sprott Physical Uranium Trust (SPUT)
